newsitem.title: UK: Eurobonds - Diary of forthcoming roadshows.
newsitem.headline: Eurobonds - Diary of forthcoming roadshows.

text.p: The following is a list of forthcoming Eurobond roadshows, compiled by Reuters, based on information received by bankers and borrowers. If you would like to contribute to this list please call Denise Manning on +44 171 542 7658. **JULY** -------- GUATEMALA
A bond for around $150 million with a maturity of up to 10 years is expected to be launched in late July by BankBoston.
A 12-year issue for $100 million is expected, via ING Barings.
